ques: Look up the current standings for the NBA Eastern Conference on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA standings page (/nba/standings) and read the Eastern Conference tables. The answer MUST report Eastern Conference teams with their current win-loss records, including the East's best-record team with its exact record, and MUST name at least six Eastern Conference teams. A Western-Conference-only answer or an answer without records FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check the latest articles on ESPN for updates on any trades that occurred in the NBA within the past 2 days.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA news page, the NBA transactions page, or a trade-related article. The answer MUST address NBA trade activity within the past 2 days relative to the site's pinned date (April 10, 2024) and MUST cite at least two real trade/player-movement facts from those pages (e.g. recent signings or the most recent trade on the transactions page); a bare 'no trades' claim with no on-page fact FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Show the scores and main highlight of the Milwaukee Bucks game that took place within the last 2 days on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Milwaukee Bucks team pages, the NBA scoreboard/schedule, or the Bucks' recent game page. The answer MUST give the final score of the Bucks game played within the last 2 days of the site's pinned date (April 10, 2024), name both teams, and state a real highlight of that game (a top performer's stat line or the page recap). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Retrieve the final score from the most recent NBA game broadcast on ESPN, including the playing teams' names and the date of the match.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA scoreboard/schedule, the all-scores page, or a recent game page. The answer MUST name both teams of the most recent finalized NBA game broadcast on ESPN with the correct final score and the match date (April 9, 2024); the accepted game must be one of the April 9, 2024 finals broadcast on ESPN, not the TNT game. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check ESPN for the final scores of NBA games that were played yesterday.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA scoreboard/schedule, the all-scores page, or game pages. The answer MUST list the NBA games played yesterday relative to the site's pinned date (April 10, 2024) with both teams and correct final scores for at least five of yesterday's matchups. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Identify the top scorer in the NBA from the latest completed game and note down the points scored, the team they play for, and their position on the team.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open a recent game page, the NBA scoreboard/schedule, or the top scorer's player profile. The answer MUST identify the game-high scorer of one of the latest completed NBA games (April 9, 2024) and state the points scored, the team they play for, and their position; a team-high scorer who was not the game-high scorer FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find the result of the latest basketball game between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Boston Celtics, including the final score and top scorer from the match.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Lakers/Celtics team pages, their game page, or the NBA scoreboard/schedule. The answer MUST give the final score of the most recent Lakers-Celtics game with both teams and the game's top scorer with his points; reporting the older Christmas Day meeting instead of the latest one FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Retrieve the final score and a brief summary of the latest NBA game played by the Los Angeles Lakers as reported on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Lakers team pages, the game page, or the NBA scoreboard/schedule. The answer MUST give the final score of the Lakers' most recent game, name the opponent, and summarize the game with facts from the page recap or box score (for example the leading scorers). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find information on ESPN about the top three scoring leaders in the NBA as of the last day of the regular season, and note which teams they play for.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA stats leaders page for points. The answer MUST name the top three scoring leaders of the 2023-24 season with their points-per-game values and the teams they play for. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search on ESPN for how many teams have Los Angeles in their name and how many of them are NBA.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST search for 'Los Angeles' on ESPN's search page or open the Los Angeles sports-teams article. The answer MUST state how many teams have 'Los Angeles' in their name and how many of them are NBA, with counts consistent with the source actually consulted (the search page yields 8 teams / 1 NBA; the article counts 9 including the LA Clippers / 2 NBA). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check ESPN for the score and a brief recap of the latest college football championship game.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the College Football section (scoreboard/schedule) or the championship game page. The answer MUST give the score of the latest college football championship game, name both teams, and include a recap anchored on the championship as stated on the game page. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: How many NBA teams are there and list all the teams with 'New' in their name.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA teams page, the NBA standings, or a 'New' search. The answer MUST state how many NBA teams there are and list all NBA teams with 'New' in their name (two teams, named with their full names). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: The first three Top Headlines in the current ESPN home page correspond to which sports leagues?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the ESPN home page. The answer MUST identify the sports leagues of the FIRST THREE Top Headlines shown in the home page's Top Headlines section, in the displayed order. Mis-ordered or wrong leagues FAIL. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Identify today's top headline in the Basketball section of ESPN, and summarize the main points of that article.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA section or today's top article. The answer MUST identify today's top headline in the Basketball section and summarize its main points, covering all three subjects of the headline article (the team milestone, the scoring record, and the injury). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find the latest news about NBA trades or player movements on ESPN and report the most recent trade deal OR player acquisition.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA transactions page (or a team's transactions page / NBA news). The answer MUST report an actual trade deal or player acquisition shown on the page — a real transaction fact (trade, signing, waive, or contract news). Injury updates or award notes alone FAIL. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check the scores of the NBA games played on December 25, 2023.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the dated NBA scoreboard for December 25, 2023 (or the NBA schedule / all-scores pages). The answer MUST list the Christmas Day NBA games with both teams and correct final scores for at least four of the five games. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check the schedule for the NBA game on December 25, 2023, and provide the teams that are playing and their current standings in their respective conferences.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the December 25, 2023 scoreboard/schedule, the NBA standings, or the two teams' pages. The answer MUST name the teams playing in the December 25 game and give their current standings records in their respective conferences. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check out the NBA Basketball Power Index 2023-24 to see which teams are in first place and which are in last place.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA Basketball Power Index page (/nba/bpi). The answer MUST identify the first-place team with its BPI value and the last-place team with its BPI value. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: How many sports leagues can you choose from on the ESPN home page?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the ESPN home page. The answer MUST state the number of sports/league sections offered in the home page's top navigation (the full count shown there). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Who has the highest salary in Boston Celtics Roster 2023-24?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Boston Celtics roster page or the Celtics payroll article. The answer MUST name the player with the highest salary on the 2023-24 roster and state that salary. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Look up the current leaders in rebounds and assists in the NBA Western Conference on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA stats leaders page filtered to the Western Conference for rebounds and assists (conference=West). The answer MUST name the Western Conference rebounds leader and the Western Conference assists leader with their per-game values. League-wide unfiltered leaders FAIL. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Show the scores and main highlight of the Denver Nuggets game that occurred within the last 3 days on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Denver Nuggets team pages, the NBA scoreboard/schedule, or the Nuggets' recent game page. The answer MUST give the final score of the Nuggets game within the last 3 days of the site's pinned date (April 10, 2024), name both teams, and state a real highlight of the game (top performer stat line or the page recap). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find the latest Team transactions in the NBA within the past week.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA transactions page (or a team's transactions page). The answer MUST report the latest NBA team transactions within the past week of the site's pinned date (April 10, 2024) — at least four real transactions with their facts (player, team, what happened). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find the result of the latest basketball game between the Miami Heat and the New York Knicks, including the final score and top rebounder from the match.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Heat/Knicks team pages, their latest game page, or the NBA scoreboard/schedule. The answer MUST give the final score of the latest Heat-Knicks game, name both teams, and identify the game's top rebounder with the rebound count. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find the final score from the most recent NFL game broadcast on ESPN, including the teams' names and the date of the match.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NFL scoreboard/schedule, the all-scores page, or a game page. The answer MUST give the final score and team names of the most recent NFL game with its match date — either the most recent game shown on ESPN's scoreboard (check the network column) or, under the broadcast-network reading, one of the most recent ESPN-broadcast games. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Identify the player with the most assists in the latest NBA game and show me the assists, the team they play for, and their position.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open a recent game page, the NBA scoreboard/schedule, or the player's profile. The answer MUST identify the player with the most assists in one of the latest completed NBA games (April 9, 2024) — the game-high assists leader — and state the assists count, the team, and the position. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find information on ESPN NBA schedule. Tell me yesterday's matchups in which the loser high was higher than the winner high.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NBA scoreboard/schedule, the all-scores page, or the game pages. The answer MUST identify yesterday's (April 9, 2024) matchups in which the losing team's high scorer outscored the winning team's high scorer, naming the qualifying matchup with both teams and the two high-scorer point totals, and at least one of the two high scorers by name; picking non-qualifying games FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search on ESPN for how many teams have 'Golden' in their name and how many of them are in the NHL.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST search for 'Golden' on ESPN's search page (or browse the NBA/NHL team lists / the golden-teams article). The answer MUST state how many teams have 'Golden' in their name and how many of them are in the NHL (naming the teams is welcome supporting evidence). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: How many MLB teams are there and list all the teams with 'City' in their name.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the MLB teams page (or the MLB standings / a 'City' search). The answer MUST state how many MLB teams there are and list every MLB team with 'City' in its name. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Identify today's top headline in the Soccer section of ESPN, and summarize the main points of that article.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Soccer section/news or today's top soccer article. The answer MUST identify today's top headline in the Soccer section and summarize its main points with at least two distinctive facts from that article. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check out the NHL Standings 2023-24 on ESPN to see which teams are at the top and which are at the bottom in Eastern and Western Conference. What about the situation in Division.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NHL standings page. The answer MUST report the top and bottom teams of the Eastern and Western Conferences and the division situation (at least two division names), consistent with the standings page — either as displayed (division rank order) or by record; at least three top-team mentions and two bottom-team mentions are required. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Who has the heaviest weight among infielders in the New York Yankees Roster 2023-24?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the New York Yankees roster page (or the Yankees preview article). The answer MUST name the heaviest infielder on the 2023-24 roster and state his weight; designating a non-infielder FAILS. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Review yesterday's NHL game results on ESPN, focusing on teams' performance.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NHL scoreboard/schedule, the all-scores page, or the game pages. The answer MUST review yesterday's (April 9, 2024) NHL game results with both teams and correct scorelines for at least four of the six games. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Locate the latest ESPN articles discussing potential MVP candidates in the NFL for 2023 season.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NFL news page, the NFL section, an MVP-related article, or an NFL MVP search. The answer MUST locate the latest ESPN article(s) discussing potential MVP candidates for the 2023 NFL season and report the latest article's subject with supporting MVP-candidate context. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Visit ESPN to view the Philadelphia 76ers' latest injuries.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Philadelphia 76ers team or injuries page. The answer MUST report the 76ers' latest injuries with player names, statuses, and injury details — including the two headline injuries and at least one more listed player. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Browse ESPN to find out when the next game of the Los Angeles Lakers will start. Then navigate to the ticket purchasing website from ESPN, what is the cheapest ticket available.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Lakers team page/schedule to find the next game, then open the ticket purchasing page linked from ESPN for that game. The answer MUST state when the Lakers' next game starts (date and tip-off time) and report the cheapest ticket available on that ticket page. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search for Lionel Messi's last 5 games, which teams has he played for, and what are the results?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open Lionel Messi's player/game-log pages, a Messi article, or search for him. The answer MUST state which team Messi plays for, cover his last five games naming at least three opponents, and give the results (at least three scorelines or a correct win/draw/loss summary). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check out LeBron James' Stats to see how many games he has played in his career so far.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open LeBron James' player profile page (his stats) or his scoring-record article. The answer MUST state how many games he has played in his career as shown by his career stats. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check Los Angeles Lakers Stats 2023-24, calculate Anthony Davis' games played (GP) percentage, tell me if there are other players with the same games played percentage as Anthony Davis.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the Lakers stats page. The answer MUST state Anthony Davis' games played, calculate his games-played percentage, and answer whether other players share that percentage (naming them). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check the New York Jets Depth Chart in the NFL section of ESPN and identify the players listed as injured in the 2ND position.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the New York Jets depth chart page. The answer MUST identify the players listed as injured in the 2ND position of the depth chart, naming at least four of them. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Browse the ESPN+ page from ESPN for a brief summary of what ESPN+ Tools is used for.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the ESPN+ page. The answer MUST summarize what ESPN+ Tools is used for, using at least three distinctive facts from the page's Tools description. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find out which four teams the NFC North contains in the NFL on ESPN.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NFL teams page (or the NFL standings). The answer MUST list the four NFC North teams. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check out NCAAM standings on ESPN, what are the teams with equal wins and losses in the America East Conference currently?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NCAAM (Men's College Basketball) standings page. The answer MUST identify the America East Conference teams with equal wins and losses, with their records (or the equivalent tied-records reading that at least includes the 11-7 pair). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Check out NCAAW recruiting on ESPN, what colleges are the top three players from?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS. MUST open the NCAAW recruiting page. The answer MUST state which colleges the top three players are committed to according to the recruiting page. An empty answer is a FAIL.
